speaker: Mina
text: On our rooftop garden, we grew basil in a twelve-liter pot with drainage holes. The holes let excess water escape after heavy rain.

speaker: Jo
text: We raised the basil pot on small feet so the drainage holes would not sit flush against the roof.

speaker: Mina
text: Each morning we pressed a finger into the soil. We watered only when the top two centimeters felt dry.

speaker: Jo
text: We skipped watering after heavy rain and emptied any standing water from the saucer.
